findings.quote: Whitening is one of the most requested cosmetic treatments, and one of the most misunderstood.
findings.why: This is a harmless general statement with no source, and its "most requested / most misunderstood" framing reads like generic AI-style filler.
findings.fix: Soften it or cut it, for example "Whitening is a popular cosmetic treatment, and many patients have questions about safety."
